mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet aggregation and can increase bleeding risk; isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with NSAIDs may potentiate hypertensive episodes and gastrointestinal bleeding through inhibition of protective prostaglandins.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration with gastroprotection (PPI) and close monitoring for bleeding and hypertensive symptoms.
